title: beckwithia glacialis subsp. camissonis
intro: Beckwithia glacialis subsp. camissonis, commonly known as Beach Strawberry, is a species of flowering plant in the family Rosaceae. This plant is known for its edible fruits, which are rich in nutrients and provide several health benefits, including antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial properties. The therapeutic actions of the Beach Strawberry include soothing skin irritations, reducing fever, and aiding in the treatment of respiratory issues. The bioactive constituents of the plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and triterpenoids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
